summary: Ming Shing Group Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 27, 2026, reporting the resignation of Chairman/CEO Weijin Li for personal reasons, effective immediately. The board re-designated Han Yan as CEO and appointed Zhijun Pan as Chairman and Director on the same date. Pan receives $1,280 monthly compensation and has ties to PMA Nano Carbon Technology Pte. Ltd., the target of a pending acquisition. No terms were disclosed for the CEO departure. This filing represents a management change event, not a routine filing. What to watch: continued execution of the pending acquisition and any further governance shifts.
